lines.text: A cold @soda_can sweats on a picnic table. A hand reaches in, cracks it open, and the fizz rises.
Macro; slow motion on the fizz.

new_beats.text: A bead of condensation slides down the @soda_can and drips onto the wood.

writes.note: I added a beat where a bead of condensation runs down the can before the hand arrives.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a moment showing the chill before the hand reaches in; a condensation drip adds it without changing the existing words.
